patches.why: 0.8.0's web build panics at startup: std::process::id() has no pid on wasm32 (storytold/deckcraft#959)
One shader module for every kernel: a single kernel a browser rejects takes the whole GPU compositor down (Safari), and Chrome's GPU watchdog loses the device (storytold/effectcraft#1590)
Safari's WebGPU refuses fxn_median_huang: its 2048-entry histogram is over WebKit's 8192-byte limit on a function's variables
The web build never autosaved: no recovery storage, and its autosave timer never fired (now_ms() is 0 on wasm), so a reload or crashed tab lost unsaved documents (storytold/photocraft#6615)
